title: Startup Wise Guys (Remote): Startup Co-Founder B2B

Sales

You’ve built strategies, managed complex projects, advised companies or led teams. Now you may be wondering what it would look like to build something of your own.

Startup Wise Guys is looking for experienced professionals who want to explore entrepreneurship, meet complementary co-founders and start building a scalable B2B company through The Founders Club.

This opportunity is particularly relevant for consultants, former consultants, operators, product leaders and senior professionals looking for a more entrepreneurial and creative next chapter.

You don’t need to leave your current job. Founders Club is a 12-week, part-time and fully online venture-building experience, designed to let you test entrepreneurship before making a major career transition.

Tasks

During the programme, you will:

Identify and validate relevant B2B problems and opportunities.
Meet potential co-founders and build a complementary founding team.
Run customer discovery and test market demand.
Define your business model and go-to-market strategy.
Build and test an MVP or proof of concept.
Develop the foundations of a scalable, investable startup.
Work with founders, mentors and investors from the Startup Wise Guys ecosystem.

You can join with an existing idea or startup, but you don’t need to have one yet.

Requirements

We are particularly interested in professionals with 7+ years of experience in:

Management consulting or strategy
Business development and sales
Product and technology
Operations
Finance
Marketing and growth
Industry-specific roles

You should be interested in entrepreneurship, comfortable solving ambiguous problems, and able to bring meaningful expertise to a potential founding team.

An MBA or MSc can be valuable, but practical experience and execution matter more.

Benefits

Over 12 weeks, you will enter the broader Startup Wise Guys ecosystem, including:

480+ startups invested in
600+ mentors and experts
Founders operating across 40+ countries
20+ portfolio exits
Around 70% portfolio survival rate
Direct access to potential co-founders, experienced entrepreneurs and early-stage investors
A structured way to explore entrepreneurship without making an immediate all-or-nothing career move

The strongest teams emerging from Founders Club may later become relevant for Startup Wise Guys’ acceleration and investment activities, subject to a separate assessment.

Selected candidates will receive further information about the programme structure, participation requirements and next steps before making any commitment.
